question: Based on Fig. ae7e0a49, What is the geographic location of the city shown in this image?

text_evidence:
City air pollution heatmap generation

To generate an air pollution heatmap for a city identified from an image, first use a geocoding service to determine the geographic coordinates of the city. Once the coordinates are obtained, generate a static map centered on the city at an appropriate zoom level to serve as the base. Finally, retrieve and overlay a PM2.5 air quality heatmap tile using the US AQI index for the same area, allowing visualization of air pollution levels across the city. This workflow integrates mapping and air quality data to provide a clear visual representation of pollution distribution.
